pages.text: Within the End, lies a structure that holds various treasures and secrets. It is rumored to be guarded by subspecies of Endermen, Enderlings.

Going through the structure, one can come across Void Keys and arenas containing Void Frames. Using said keys on the frames will summon forth a powerful creature, that drops a Void Shard when slain. The structure also contains vaults that can be opened with the keys.

On top of the terminal lies a Void Shrine. It requires four Void Shards to be inserted before a powerful warrior is summoned. Defeating the warrior will cause an object to appear, placed on the Void Shrine, that can give a monstrous secret.
